project.name: ${project.artifactId}
project.description:
This package contains technical components, where each subpackage represents a component. Each component consists of two parts:
1. The `core` package: the core implementation/wrapper of the component 2. The `config` package: the Spring-based configuration for the component
Technical components are also divided into two categories:
1. Framework components: extensions of familiar technologies such as Jpa, Redis, etc. 2. Business components: encapsulations of business-related features, such as data dictionaries, operation logs, and so on.
If it is a business component, its Maven name will include `biz`.
